text:
nina-mktg: Heads-up from the weekly KPI pass      Launch messaging B shows far higher signups but the MQL tile drops ~30%. Can analytics/ops eyeball attribution? :thinking_face:
rahul-analytics: saw that too. Variant B CTR -> regs strong, but MQL conversion lower. First cut: dashboard filters only include campaign_id=launch_main, and our A/B test writes campaign_id to a different field (campaign_alias) for variant B. Could be filter mismatch.
ben-ops: we rolled a small router change that started populating campaign_alias for split tests last week. That could explain it. I'll grep routing logs.
claire-growth: also check webinar linkage. Some registrants came via webinar promo widget which stamps webinar_id but not campaign_id; dashboards join on campaign_id so those could be dropped.
rahul-analytics: quick debug snippet I'm running: ```sql
SELECT message_variant, count(*) as regs, sum(is_mql::int) as mqls
FROM lead_events
WHERE event_date >= '2026-04-01' AND campaign_family = 'q2_launch'
GROUP BY 1;
```
dashboard-bot: KPI deck auto-update: https://dash.redwood.ai/reports/q2-launch-perf (viewers: nina-mktg, claire-growth, rahul-analytics) :link:
ben-ops: grep shows mapping lines: `2026-04-04T02:07Z map: split_test.slot=variant_b -> campaign_alias=launch_b` and `2026-04-04T02:07Z router: webinar_widget sets webinar_id but not campaign_id`. So yes, variant B rows end up outside the campaign_id filter.
rahul-analytics: I'll run a joins audit and estimate how many MQLs are excluded due to missing campaign_id. If it's material we'll backfill and update the KPI slide.
nina-mktg: For the deck narrative I want: "Variant B drove strong registration lift; apparent MQL gap driven by instrumentation (campaign_id vs campaign_alias + webinar_id joins). Ops/Analytics are remapping and backfilling; headline to be updated after reconciliation." Keep it succinct.
claire-growth: Also propose adding a micro-metric to the deck: "percent leads with campaign_id present" and a second micro-card "message variant to MQL conversion" so we can spot this faster.
ben-ops: I'll add a mapping shim to translate campaign_alias -> campaign_id for the analytics view and kick a backfill for the last 10 days. Will also add an alert if campaign_id missing > 1% for major cohorts. ETA ~2.5 hrs.
rahul-analytics: After backfill I'll produce a small before/after delta table and slide. If MQLs recover we'll keep the benchmark phrasing positive; if not we'll dig deeper into variant messaging quality.
nina-mktg: Thanks all. Can we reconvene Friday morning to lock the KPI narrative? If backfill fixes it we say "instrumentation issue"; otherwise we call out "variant performance review". :calendar:
